item.title: Thousands of new targets acquired: what the next phase of the Iran war could look like
item.summary: After a week focused on missile launchers and stockpiles, Israel and the United States are shifting to strike Iran’s military industry, targeting factories, assembly plants and supply chains behind its missiles and drones in a bid to cripple production

item.title: Iran and Hezbollah launched coordinated missile attack to overwhelm Israeli air defenses, IDF says
item.summary: In recent days, the number of missiles fired toward Israel from Iran has declined compared with the early days of the war; at the same time, rocket and drone launches by Hezbollah from Lebanon have increased

item.title: 'Next phase' of war begins: IDF strikes highly sensitive defense industry site in Iran
item.summary: Airstrike hits the Parchin defense site near Tehran, long tied to missile production and suspected nuclear weapons research, as Israel expands attacks on Iran’s military industry

item.title: With focus on Iran, IDF turns to deception against Hamas in Gaza
item.summary: While Israel’s focus and resources shift to Iran and Lebanon, troops in Gaza continue facing Hamas attempts to regroup and challenge positions along yellow line, using ruses and creative tactics to offset reduced air support and keep terrorists off balance

item.title: Watch: with Khamenei gone, IDF obliterates Iranian supreme leader’s Tehran bunker in massive airstrike
item.summary: About 50 Israeli fighter jets dropped more than 100 munitions on vast underground command complex beneath Iran’s leadership compound in Tehran, military says

item.title: Iran missile fire downed over southern Israel; Katz vows to 'defeat Hezbollah' as north battered
item.summary: No injuries reported in barrage toward Negev and Dead Sea area; IDF strikes highly sensitive defense industry sites in Iran; Hezbollah launches rockets and drones along northern border, setting off warnings from Lebanon frontier to Haifa

item.title: 'Maximum precision, seconds to execute': how Israeli jets refuel midair on their way to strike Iran
item.summary: Aerial refueling keeps Israeli jets flying deep into Iran: the 120th Squadron has carried out 550-plus midair refuelings since the war began, with crews given only seconds to connect the boom and minutes to fuel aircraft before strikes continue

item.title: Watch: Iranian TV reporter flees live on air as Israeli strike hits again
item.summary: State broadcaster correspondent reporting from a bombed neighborhood in Tehran interrupted by fresh explosions during live broadcast as Israel carries out its 14th wave of strikes on the capital and US-Israeli attacks expand across Iran

item.title: Wave of strikes in Beirut’s Dahieh; US says B-2 bombers hit underground missile sites, 30 Iranian vessels sunk
item.summary: US says B-2 bombers struck Iran’s underground missile facilities as Israeli airstrikes pounded Beirut’s Dahieh; Iranian vessels reported sunk and regional tensions escalate

item.title: Iran launches barrage; drone found at Nahariya hospital parking lot as CENTCOM says 3,000 targets hit
item.summary: Millions in central Israel rushed to shelters three times overnight as sirens sounded across the country; US military says more than 3,000 targets hit in Iran during first week of war; Trump: 'Two sets of their leaders are gone'
